novelty_flags.label: thm:hall-characterization
novelty_flags.one_line: The statement expressly restates Dahl2008 Theorem 4 after reindexing, so it is published prior art and should be an imported supporting fact rather than a proposed result.

soundness_flags.label: prop:endpoint-sanity-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: This is only numerical substitution into the already stated endpoint formula and a singleton feasible plan; retain it as an implementation test or remark, not a result target.

soundness_flags.label: thm:pairwise-regret-and-minimax
soundness_flags.one_line: The two displayed formulas are obtained by cancelling the two definitions of J_m and J_j and then applying the definitions of R_m and argmin; the decision contribution belongs in the joint-value and separation theorems.

soundness_flags.label: prop:signed-pairwise-sanity
soundness_flags.one_line: The claim is a direct evaluation of the definitions on the sole feasible transport cell and is content-free as a standalone proposition.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:capped-capacity and the causal/decision headline
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The joint-capacity restriction B+W≤H is a substantive externally prespecified sensitivity condition, not derived from randomized-trial data or separate capping.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All sharp endpoints, causal lifts, value sets, and regret conclusions are conditional on an externally justified and prespecified capacity-sensitivity restriction.

source_verification_receipts.version: Linear Algebra and its Applications 429(7) (2008), journal-PDF text, pp. 1844-1846
source_verification_receipts.locator: Theorem 4, p. 1845; Algorithm NWC and its proof, pp. 1845-1846
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 characterizes nonempty fixed-margin staircase transportation classes by critical-position inequalities, and the proof constructs a feasible matrix with the North-West Corner algorithm.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3-4, Assumption 1 and Proposition 1; pp. 4-5, Section 3.2
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Assumption 1 equates the switched post-landmark residual distribution among intensive survivors with the standard-arm residual distribution among standard survivors; Proposition 1 gives sharp scalar bounds for a threshold-selected switching estimand, and the paper defines value and regret functions for dynamic regimes.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 3, especially the achievability discussion surrounding Theorems 10, 13, and 15
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper revisits sharp fixed-marginal bounds for the distribution of an unrestricted sum and treats the distinction between weak and strict events when margins have atoms.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Sections 4.1-4.2 and 5 as indexed in the arXiv HTML record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies recurrent events with a terminal event under coarsening at random, identifies observed-data functionals, derives an efficiency bound, and develops multiply robust estimation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Remove the Dahl reindexing theorem and both arithmetic sanity propositions from the proposed-result list; cite Dahl as an imported feasibility input and retain the examples only as executable audit fixtures.

Make the field headline solely the open-family strict separation theorem: state explicitly that it strictly improves JanvinRyalenSarvetStensrud2025's thresholdwise scalar-bound decision rule for a finite threshold menu under the stated capacity class.

Add a concrete externally defensible capacity mechanism and prespecification protocol for at least one recurrent-event setting, together with a cap-feasibility sensitivity analysis; otherwise keep all clinical claims explicitly conditional.

Develop the open inference handle into a theorem with a stated nuisance-rate class and an explicit bootstrap or moment-selection statistic, so the finite-dimensional inclusion result becomes an implementable censoring-adjusted procedure.

recommended_next_step: Revise by demoting published and purely definitional support items to citations/tests, preserve the capacity condition as an accepted conditional scope, and advance the causal-lift plus open-family shared-law separation kernel to Stage 0.
